name: @kickside/settings-ui
title: KickSide Settings
description: Admin settings editor web component for kickside/settings.

wippy.description: Admin settings editor mounted by the host as <kickside-settings>. It fetches the block list from GET /api/v1/settings/blocks (declared kickside.settings:block entries plus auto-blocks for every settings namespace with a visible definition) and renders a grouped left-nav plus a content pane: a block with a component_tag mounts that bespoke editor web component by tag, while a block with a namespace renders the generic per-value-type settings form scoped to it. The optional route attribute deep-links to a block by key; when unset or unknown the first block is selected. The bundle's separate provider.js entry ships <kickside-settings-provider>, a shared config-driven provider settings card that takes a JSON config attribute ({ namespace, title?, icon?, help? }) and renders that namespace's declared settings. Neither element emits custom events beyond the standard bridge lifecycle events (load, unload, error). All settings lists every visible declaration across namespaces in a searchable Owner, Setting and Value table, using the same controls and save/reset operations as section editors.

route.description: Deep-link to a settings block by key. Unset selects the first block.
